stem:
Riya, a Class 7 student, is learning about living a balanced social life during adolescence. Which of the following statements about respectful interaction and responsible use of social media is incorrect ( )
A. Being polite and respectful to friends and family, both in person and online, is part of a balanced social life.
B. Sharing a classmate's personal photos without their permission is acceptable if the photos are shared only with close friends.
C. Spreading false rumours about someone on social media can hurt them just as much as saying it face-to-face.
D. Thinking carefully before posting a message online shows responsible behaviour during adolescence.

options.text: Being polite and respectful to friends and family, both in person and online, is part of a balanced social life.
Sharing a classmate's personal photos without their permission is acceptable if the photos are shared only with close friends.
Spreading false rumours about someone on social media can hurt them just as much as saying it face-to-face.
Thinking carefully before posting a message online shows responsible behaviour during adolescence.

teacher.key_rationale: Sharing a classmate's personal information or photos without consent is irresponsible online behaviour, regardless of the size of the audience, so statement B is the incorrect one. A, C and D correctly describe respectful interaction and responsible social media use as parts of a balanced social life during adolescence.
